events.title: Let's Play In The Park
events.description:
This is a FREE, supervised DROP-IN outdoor program where you will enjoy a mix of games, sports, crafts, theme days, and special events right in your local neighbourhood park!

Participation is on a first come first serve basis.

All our programs are supervised by qualified staff trained in HIGH FIVE principles of healthy child development.

Parent / guardians will be required to complete program forms for the first day attending program.

Safe Arrival and Dismissal: Parent/legal/caregivers must accompany the child to the sign-in area. Parent/guardians must list the names of all adults authorized to pick up their child at the time of registration. Photo identification must be shown by parent/legal guardian/caregiver at pick‑up each day.

For more program information, please visit: www.mississauga.ca/play
